title.zh: SpaceX收购低频段频谱，瞄准美国无线运营商
title.en: SpaceX收购低频段频谱，瞄准美国无线运营商

current_state.zh: SpaceX struck a deal to acquire Grain Management's nationwide 800 MHz low-band spectrum for Starlink Mobile's direct-to-smartphone service, pending FCC approval, while the FCC also cleared its 15,000-satellite Gen2 constellation.
current_state.en: SpaceX struck a deal to acquire Grain Management's nationwide 800 MHz low-band spectrum for Starlink Mobile's direct-to-smartphone service, pending FCC approval, while the FCC also cleared its 15,000-satellite Gen2 constellation.
